Nina (PM): Heads-up: planning decision thread for model lifecycle rules we want to lock before next roadmap review. Short bullets so we can turn into an RFC.

Nina (PM): Draft decisions I want agreement on:
- Onboarding gates: functional correctness + regression score; sample size min 200 prompts or tiered review for low-volume tenants
- Performance: lane-based SLOs (short <128 tokens: p50 <90ms, p95 <320ms; med <512 tokens: p50 <140ms, p95 <520ms; long >=512 tokens: p50 <260ms, p95 <900ms)
- Pin policy: default TTL 45d, renewal requires explicit customer action or contract clause; emergency "freeze" for audits available with legal sign-off
- Deprecation cadence: 45d notice + staggered cutover: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 14 days with opt-out windows for enterprise
- Rollout automation: ramp plan + automated rollback on error-rate spike >0.5% sustained 5m or latency breach in any lane

Tariq (Eng Runtime): Lane SLOs look reasonable. A couple notes:
- Ramp plan %s should be configurable per model. Some heavy-context models need slower ramps.
- For rollback, prefer a 3-out-of-4-canary rule: if 3 canaries >threshold within 10m, trigger fallback.

Priya (Applied ML): On correctness/regression checks:
- Use a two-tier eval: house probe set (stable) + tenant sample. Accept if overall regression <=1.5% and no catastrophic failure on top-10 prompts.
- For embeddings, threshold of median cosine >= 0.987 on probe set. Add a distributional test (KS-test) to detect tail shifts.
- Recommend we run multi-seed generation (k=3) for stochastic models to estimate variance, then require pass across n/3 seeds for small tenants.

Jordan (Customer Success): Customer asks summarized:
- Audited customers want 1 year pin options + exportable model artifacts and deterministic traces.
- They also want a self-serve pin renewal request with SLA for response (24-48h).

Liam (Legal): We can support longer pins via contract addendum but need migration guarantees and data export/retention specs. Also must ensure we have a clear liability clause if model regresses while pinned.

Nina (PM): Suggested compromise:
- Default 45d TTL. Enterprise addendum for 365d pin with migration credits and quarterly migration review.
- Provide a "freeze for audit" flow: customer requests -> legal approval -> creates immutable snapshot export + freeze flag (no auto-updates)

Tariq (Eng Runtime): Implementation items:
- Need canary groups: internal synthetic, small live cohort, and a high-load cohort. We'll support 4 canaries by default.
- Build ramp engine to apply configurable percentages per phase and to auto-rollback on the 3-of-4 rule.
- Pin renewals: add API + CS UI + audit trail events.

Priya (Applied ML): Telemetry we need:
- Per-prompt signal: pass/fail, bleu-like metric for classification/regression difference, embedding drift, and seed variance stats.
- Alerting: if median embedding drops >0.01 or KS p-value < 0.01, flag for human review.

Jordan (Customer Success): Ops wish list:
- Self-serve renewal button surfaced in Console with required acceptance checklist.
- A queue for pending pin-extension requests with CS prioritization.

ops-bot: New action items created: TASK-451 prototype ramp engine, TASK-452 pin-UI mockups, TASK-453 eval-harness for multi-seed testing.

Liam (Legal): I'll draft a short addendum template for 365d pins and the audit freeze flow; will loop in Jordan for customer language.

Nina (PM): OK next steps: Tariq and Priya to spike ramp + eval infra (2 sprints), Jordan + Liam to draft customer-facing pin exception terms, I'll convert this thread into RFC draft by EOW. Any objections?

Tariq (Eng Runtime): No objections. Will start spike.

Priya (Applied ML): No objections. I'll pair with infra on metrics.

Jordan (Customer Success): No objections. Will collect customer examples to justify addendum language.

Liam (Legal): No objections.

Nina (PM): Great, closing thread. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
